text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Today's the day. The Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm here because of the support of
everyone at
the Hanshin and Kyoto
Racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I will! Everyone's waited for me,
so I'll
run my
heart out in return.
choice_data_list: Go out there and live up to everyo...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I may be useless... I may cause everyone
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I can run... So I'll do just that,
all the
way up
to the finish line!
